title: Give credit while the details are still visible
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Notice the work — Identify a specific contribution beyond the visible milestone.; Name its effect — Explain what the contribution changed or made possible.; Choose the setting — Match acknowledgment to context and personal preference.; Preserve the record — Keep attribution attached to the explanation or artifact..
